coverage_gap.note: AOV historical market custody covers ~104 primary securities, not Full-W3 (~5k). Economic estimand requires Full-W3 PIT-EW under same return law; cannot fabricate Full-W3 returns.

payoff.reason_if_null: Full-W3 market total-return / close custody not admitted for economic estimand; refuse invent; refuse asymmetric AOV-104 proxy as Full-W3 denominator.

policy.score_inputs: frozen continuous FTK node scores (INV lag-1 delta; MARGIN M1 state)

selection.reason_if_not: Blocked before selection payoff: Full-W3 R_net unobservable

session_arithmetic.decision_asof: PIT as-of under conservative EOD law (FTK primitive spirit)
session_arithmetic.entry: official close on first session after decision_asof + lag
session_arithmetic.exit: official close after exactly 63 sessions of exposure from entry
session_arithmetic.inclusive_session_arithmetic: Let t0 = decision_asof session. Entry session tE = next trading session after t0 (lag=1). Exit session tX = trading session H_VALUE steps after tE (H=63). Holding-period return uses close[tX]/close[tE]-1 under chosen return series; costs 20 bps RT on selected only. Deterministic & frozen.
session_arithmetic.return_series_policy: admitted market total-return if available for W3 custody; else CLOSE_TO_CLOSE flagged CLOSE_TO_CLOSE_NOT_DIVIDEND_COMPLETE
session_arithmetic.symmetry_law: FTK selected book and Full-W3 PIT-EW use identical return law

stability.note: Identical fold law to sensing L5; not re-invented.
